200.description: The new session cookie is set and its expiry returned

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot be used for this request`.

description:
Sets a new session cookie that is valid 1 hour from now, for a signed-in user who is still active. The web interface calls it before the session ends. A signed-in session is needed: API tokens are refused with 403.

Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused)
